CustomField.description: インボイス制度開始に合わせ、2023/10/1以降は自動車税相当額を課税対象として計算
CustomField.formula: IF( PurchaseDate__c < DATE( 2023, 10, 1 ) , IF( ByRecyclingFee__c = true , IF( TaxExcluded__c = true , ProposedPrice__c *1.1 , ProposedPrice__c ) + RecyclingFee__c + IF( CarTax_Excluded__c = true , CarTax__c , 0 ) + invoice_amount__c , IF( TaxExcluded__c = true , ProposedPrice__c *1.1 , ProposedPrice__c ) + IF( CarTax_Excluded__c = true , CarTax__c , 0 ) + invoice_amount__c ) , IF( ByRecyclingFee__c = true , IF( TaxExcluded__c = true , ProposedPrice__c *1.1 , ProposedPrice__c ) + RecyclingFee__c + IF( CarTax_Excluded__c = true , CarTax__c *1.1 , 0 ) + invoice_amount__c , IF( TaxExcluded__c = true , ProposedPrice__c *1.1 , ProposedPrice__c ) + IF( CarTax_Excluded__c = true , CarTax__c *1.1 , 0 ) + invoice_amount__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 「税別」「リサイクル料金別」「自動車税相当額別」にチェックが入れば、それぞれの金額が足されて算出されます。
